_meta.approval: pricing and max_fee; amount and currency are explicit

description: Make a binding offer or counter the exact current proposal. Use it to negotiate an item price; use reply for discussion or respond to accept, decline or withdraw. Accepted proposals cost 6 SBZ and may notify the other participant. Amount is a decimal string in the declared currency, e.g. 123 USD; the current ceiling is asking plus 16%, with 24-hour expiry. Approve terms, pricing and max_fee; counters bind offerId/offerHash. Retry the same request_id and arguments. It returns the accepted or refused native decision and billing.

0.description: Exact published document or pricing version; copy it from the preceding read.

1.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact returned content or authority.

acceptTerms.description: Set true only after the person approves these exact terms. true: explicitly approve the stated condition.

amount.description: Exact decimal string in the selected/listing currency, e.g. "123" with currency "USD" (123 USD); never a float or SBZ fee.

contactConsent.description: Exact version and SHA-256 of the sale-contact disclosure explicitly approved.

conversation_id.description: Existing private conversation identity; do not invent a new thread. UUID.

currency.description: Exact currency symbol/descriptor returned by the listing or offer; do not convert the native amount.

lot_id.description: Stable listing UUID; it is distinct from a sale publication.

max_fee.description: Approved immediate service fee ceiling as a whole SBZ string; separate from the item price.

note.description: Optional private offer note; not separate trading authority.

offerHash.description: SHA-256 of that exact offer; binds price and participants.

offerId.description: Exact current offer identity returned by the thread.

pricing.description: Exact published fee schedule reference approved for this action.

revision.description: Exact published revision; copy it rather than predicting the next value.

request_id.description: UUID for one logical request; reuse it with identical arguments after uncertainty. UUID.

saleId.description: Exact sale identity returned by discovery or the conversation.

share_token.description: Unguessable token from the exact secret share link. It grants viewing only; normal account, participation and trading requirements still apply.

termsHash.description: SHA-256 of the exact sale terms the person approved.

name: offer

0.description: Native price plus a nonbinding estimate in the account display currency. Estimates never authorize or change payment.

conversion_status.description: Delayed after three minutes; unavailable after fifteen minutes. Same-currency amounts need no FX rate.

converted_amount.description: Display estimate with the same rounding as the website; null if no usable rate.

currency.description: Original currency code or frozen currency descriptor.

rate_observed_at.description: ISO 8601 rate observation time, null when unavailable or same currency.

billing.description: charged, assessed, balance and available_credits are whole SBZ strings or null; receipt_id identifies the saved fee. Replays never charge twice.

committed_stages.description: Stages already committed before a later refusal; retain their receipts.

data.description: Exact requestId, offer or refusal, public native price and decision receipt. IDs are exact returned identifiers (UUID where declared); prices retain amount/currency (123 USD); times use ISO 8601 UTC; cursors are opaque.

error.description: Optional business error: code, message, HTTP status, retryable and recovery details.

next.description: Exactly one required continuation: call, input, approval, choice, wait or done. It never grants new consent.

pagination.description: Optional next-page call; not required work or consent.

retry.description: Optional exact request_id and permitted recovery call.

state.description: Outcome: finished, still processing, needs approval/input, or refused.

summary.description: Plain-language result, including a business error.

title: Make or counter an offer
